title: एकनवत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 291 · The imperishable and the perishable

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks what is called the imperishable from which there is no return, and what the perishable from which there is return. Vasishtha answers by the Sankhya reckoning, naming the twenty-four principles and the twenty-fifth who is known by knowledge.
summary.kn: ಯಾವುದರಿಂದ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲವೋ ಅದು ಅಕ್ಷರ, ಯಾವುದರಿಂದ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗುವುದೋ ಅದು ಕ್ಷರವೆಂದರೇನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಸಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಂಖ್ಯ ಲೆಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತನಾಲ್ಕು ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು, ಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂದ ತಿಳಿಯಬಹುದಾದ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೈದನೆಯವನನ್ನು ಹೆಸರಿಸಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि जिससे वापसी नहीं होती उस अक्षर और जिससे वापसी होती है उस क्षर से क्या अभिप्राय है। वसिष्ठ सांख्य गणना से चौबीस तत्त्वों और ज्ञान से जाने जाने वाले पच्चीसवें का नाम लेकर उत्तर देते हैं।
summary.te: ఏదైతే తిరిగి రాదో ఆ అక్షరం, ఏదైతే తిరిగి వస్తుందో ఆ క్షరం అంటే ఏమిటని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. వసిష్ఠుడు సాంఖ్య గణనతో ఇరవై నాలుగు తత్త్వాలను, జ్ఞానంతో తెలిసే ఇరవై ఐదవవాణ్ని పేర్కొంటూ బదులిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: எதிலிருந்து திரும்புதல் இல்லையோ அது அக்ஷரம், எதிலிருந்து திரும்புதல் உண்டோ அது க்ஷரம் என்றால் என்ன என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, வசிஷ்டர் சாங்கிய கணக்கில் இருபத்துநான்கு தத்துவங்களையும் அறிவால் அறியப்படும் இருபத்தைந்தாவதையும் பெயரிட்டுப் பதிலளிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: തിരിച്ചുവരവില്ലാത്ത അക്ഷരമെന്നും, തിരിച്ചുവരവുള്ള ക്ഷരമെന്നും വിളിക്കുന്നതെന്തെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; സാംഖ്യകണക്കിൽ ഇരുപത്തിനാലു തത്ത്വങ്ങളെയും, അറിവാൽ അറിയപ്പെടുന്ന ഇരുപത്തിഅഞ്ചാമനെയും വസിഷ്ഠൻ പേരെടുത്തു പറഞ്ഞ് മറുപടി നൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.291; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
किं तदक्षरमित्युक्तं यस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः ।
किं च तत्क्षरमित्युक्तं यस्मादावर्तते पुनः ॥

meaning.en: What is that called the imperishable, from which there is no return? And what is that called the perishable, from which there is a return?

verses.text:
अक्षरक्षरयोर्व्यक्तिमिच्छाम्यरिनिषूदन ।
उपलब्धुं महाबाहो तत्त्वेन कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Slayer of foes, mighty-armed joy of the Kurus, I wish to understand the distinction of the imperishable and the perishable as it truly is.

verses.text:
त्वं हि ज्ञाननिधिर्विप्रैरुच्यसे वेदपारगैः ।
ऋषिभिश्च महाभागैर्यतिभिश्च महात्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: For you are called a treasury of knowledge by Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas, by greatly fortunate sages and great-souled ascetics.

verses.text:
शेषमल्पं दिनानां ते दक्षिणायनभास्करे ।
आवृत्ते भगवत्यर्के गन्तासि परमां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Few days remain for you while the sun is in its southern course; when the blessed sun turns back, you will go to the highest goal.

verses.text:
त्वयि प्रतिगते श्रेयः कुतः श्रोष्यामहे वयम् ।
कुरुवंशप्रदीपस्त्वं ज्ञानद्रव्येण दीप्यसे ॥

meaning.en: When you have gone, from whom shall we hear of the highest good? You are the lamp of the Kuru line, shining with the wealth of knowledge.

verses.text:
तदेतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्तः कुरुकुलोद्वह ।
न तृप्यामीह राजेन्द्र शृण्वन्नमृतमीदृशम् ॥

meaning.en: So I wish to hear this from you, bearer of the Kuru house; king of kings, I am not satisfied here with hearing such nectar.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्र ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
वसिष्ठस्य च संवादं करालजनकस्य च ॥

meaning.en: On this I will relate to you an ancient account, the conversation of Vasishtha and Karala Janaka.

verses.text:
वसिष्ठं श्रेष्ठमासीनमृषीणां भास्करद्युतिम् ।
पप्रच्छ जनको राजा ज्ञानं नैःश्रेयसं परम् ॥

meaning.en: Janaka, the king, asked Vasishtha, the best of sages, seated and shining like the sun, about the highest knowledge of the supreme good.

verses.text:
परमध्यात्मकुशलमध्यात्मगतिनिश्चयम् ।
मैत्रावरुणिमासीनमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः ॥

meaning.en: Having saluted with folded hands the son of Mitra and Varuna, seated, who was supremely skilled in the self and certain of the course of the self,

verses.text:
स्वक्षरं प्रश्रितं वाक्यं मधुरं चाप्यनुल्बणम् ।
पप्रच्छर्षिवरं राजा करालजनकः पुरा ॥

meaning.en: King Karala Janaka long ago put this question to the best of sages in well-formed, humble, sweet and gentle words:

verses.text:
भगवञ्श्रोतुमिच्छामि परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
यस्मान्न पुनरावृत्तिमाप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Revered sir, I wish to hear of the eternal supreme Brahman, from which the wise attain no return,

verses.text:
यच्च तत्क्षरमित्युक्तं यत्रेदं क्षरते जगत् ।
यच्चाक्षरमिति प्रोक्तं शिवं क्षेम्यमनामयम् ॥

meaning.en: and of what is called the perishable, in which this world perishes, and of what is called the imperishable, auspicious, secure and free of ills.

verses.text: वसिष्ठ उवाच

meaning.en: Vasishtha said:

verses.text:
श्रूयतां पृथिवीपाल क्षरतीदं यथा जगत् ।
यन्न क्षरति पूर्वेण यावत्कालेन चाप्यथ ॥

meaning.en: Hear, lord of the earth, how this world perishes, and what does not perish, and in how much time.

verses.text:
युगं द्वादशसाहस्रं कल्पं विद्धि चतुर्गुणम् ।
दशकल्पशतावृत्तं तदहर्ब्राह्ममुच्यते ।
रात्रिश्चैतावती राजन्यस्यान्ते प्रतिबुध्यते ॥

meaning.en: Know a yuga to be twelve thousand years, a kalpa to be four times that; ten hundred kalpas make one day of Brahma, and the night is as long, king, at whose end he wakes.

verses.text:
सृजत्यनन्तकर्माणं महान्तं भूतमग्रजम् ।
मूर्तिमन्तममूर्तात्मा विश्वं शंभुः स्वयंभुवः ।
अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिरीशानं ज्योतिरव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: The one who is formless in nature, Shambhu, creates the Great Being of unlimited action, the first born of the self-born, who takes form, the universe; he has minuteness, lightness and attainment, the lord, imperishable light.

verses.text:
सर्वतःपाणिपादान्तं सर्वतोक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतःश्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: He stands covering all, with hands and feet on every side, with eyes, heads and faces on every side, with ears in every direction in the world.

verses.text:
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानेष बुद्धिरिति स्मृतः ।
महानिति च योगेषु विरिञ्च इति चाप्युत ॥

meaning.en: This blessed one is remembered as Hiranyagarbha, as Buddhi, as Mahat in the yoga texts, and also as Virinchi.

verses.text:
सांख्ये च पठ्यते शास्त्रे नामभिर्बहुधात्मकः ।
विचित्ररूपो विश्वात्मा एकाक्षर इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: He is recited in the Sankhya scripture under many names, as many-formed, as the soul of the universe, and is remembered as the single syllable.

verses.text:
वृतं नैकात्मकं येन कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यमात्मना ।
तथैव बहुरूपत्वाद्विश्वरूप इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: The Self by which the whole triple world is pervaded, not of one nature, is remembered as universal-formed because of his many forms.

verses.text:
एष वै विक्रियापन्नः सृजत्यात्मानमात्मना ।
अहंकारं महातेजाः प्रजापतिमहंकृतम् ॥

meaning.en: He, undergoing change, creates himself by himself, the one of great brilliance, and creates egoism, the Prajapati who is made of "I."

verses.text:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तमुत्पन्नं विद्यासर्गं वदन्ति तम् ।
महान्तं चाप्यहंकारमविद्यासर्गमेव च ॥

meaning.en: From the unmanifest the manifest arises; they call that the creation of knowledge. The great principle and egoism are the creation of ignorance.

verses.text:
अविधिश्च विधिश्चैव समुत्पन्नौ तथैकतः ।
विद्याविद्येति विख्याते श्रुतिशास्त्रार्थचिन्तकैः ॥

meaning.en: Absence of rule and rule arose together as one; scholars of scripture and treatise call these knowledge and ignorance.

verses.text:
भूतसर्गमहंकारात्तृतीयं विद्धि पार्थिव ।
अहंकारेषु भूतेषु चतुर्थं विद्धि वैकृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Know, king, that the creation of elements from egoism is the third; and know the fourth to be the modified one, in the elements born of egoism.

verses.text:
वायुर्ज्योतिरथाकाशमापोऽथ पृथिवी तथा ।
शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Wind, fire, space, water and earth, and sound, touch, form, taste and smell as well,

verses.text:
एवं युगपदुत्पन्नं दशवर्गमसंशयम् ।
पञ्चमं विद्धि राजेन्द्र भौतिकं सर्गमर्थवत् ॥

meaning.en: thus arisen together, form a group of ten without doubt. Know the fifth, king of kings, to be the elemental creation with its purpose.

verses.text:
श्रोत्रं त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणमेव च पञ्चमम् ।
वाक्च हस्तौ च पादौ च पायुर्मेढ्रं तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Ear, skin, eyes, tongue, and nose as fifth; speech, hands, feet, the organ of excretion and likewise the organ of generation:

verses.text:
बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि चैतानि तथा कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च ।
संभूतानीह युगपन्मनसा सह पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: these are the organs of knowledge and also the organs of action, and they have arisen here together with the mind, king.

verses.text:
एषा तत्त्वचतुर्विंशा सर्वाकृतिषु वर्तते ।
यां ज्ञात्वा नाभिशोचन्ति ब्राह्मणास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥

meaning.en: This set of twenty-four principles exists in all forms; knowing it, Brahmins who see the truth do not grieve.

verses.text:
एतद्देहं समाख्यातं त्रैलोक्ये सर्वदेहिषु ।
वेदितव्यं नरश्रेष्ठ सदेवनरदानवे ॥

meaning.en: This body is described in the three worlds in all embodied beings, best of men, among gods, men and Danavas,

verses.text:
सयक्षभूतगन्धर्वे सकिंनरमहोरगे ।
सचारणपिशाचे वै सदेवर्षिनिशाचरे ॥

meaning.en: with Yakshas, spirits and Gandharvas, Kinnaras and great serpents, Charanas, Pishachas, divine sages and night-wanderers,

verses.text:
सदंशकीटमशके सपूतिकृमिमूषके ।
शुनि श्वपाके वैणेये सचण्डाले सपुल्कसे ॥

meaning.en: with gadflies, insects and mosquitoes, with stinking worms and mice, with dogs, dog-cookers, Vainas, Chandalas and Pulkasas,

verses.text:
हस्त्यश्वखरशार्दूले सवृक्षे गवि चैव ह ।
यच्च मूर्तिमयं किंचित्सर्वत्रैतन्निदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: with elephants, horses, donkeys, tigers, trees and cows; whatever has form is a sign of this everywhere,

verses.text:
जले भुवि तथाकाशे नान्यत्रेति विनिश्चयः ।
स्थानं देहवतामस्ति इत्येवमनुशुश्रुम ॥

meaning.en: in water, on earth and in the sky, not elsewhere; so it is settled. We have heard that this is the abode of the embodied.

verses.text:
कृत्स्नमेतावतस्तात क्षरते व्यक्तसंज्ञकम् ।
अहन्यहनि भूतात्मा ततः क्षर इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: All that is called manifest perishes so far, dear one; day by day the soul of beings perishes, so it is remembered as perishable.

verses.text:
एतदक्षरमित्युक्तं क्षरतीदं यथा जगत् ।
जगन्मोहात्मकं प्राहुरव्यक्तं व्यक्तसंज्ञकम् ॥

meaning.en: This is called the imperishable, as this world perishes. They call the world, which is made of delusion, the unmanifest named manifest.

verses.text:
महांश्चैवाग्रजो नित्यमेतत्क्षरनिदर्शनम् ।
कथितं ते महाराज यस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः ॥

meaning.en: The Great and the First-born is always the proof of the perishable. It has been told to you, great king, that from which there is no return.

verses.text:
पञ्चविंशतिमो विष्णुर्निस्तत्त्वस्तत्त्वसंज्ञकः ।
तत्त्वसंश्रयणादेतत्तत्त्वमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: The twenty-fifth is Vishnu, without principle, named the principle; the wise call this a principle because it rests on the principles.

verses.text:
यदमूर्त्यसृजद्व्यक्तं तत्तन्मूर्त्यधितिष्ठति ।
चतुर्विंशतिमो व्यक्तो ह्यमूर्तः पञ्चविंशकः ॥

meaning.en: Whatever manifest thing the formless creates, he presides over it in form; the twenty-fourth is manifest, the twenty-fifth is formless.

verses.text:
स एव हृदि सर्वासु मूर्तिष्वातिष्ठतेऽऽत्मवान् ।
चेतयंश्चेतनो नित्यः सर्वमूर्तिरमूर्तिमान् ॥

meaning.en: He alone, possessed of self, abides in the heart in all forms, conscious, making conscious, eternal, the form of all and yet formless.

verses.text:
सर्गप्रलयधर्मिण्या असर्गप्रलयात्मकः ।
गोचरे वर्तते नित्यं निर्गुणो गुणसंज्ञकः ॥

meaning.en: Though without creation and dissolution, he is in what is subject to creation and dissolution, always in the field of experience, without qualities yet called by qualities.

verses.text:
एवमेष महानात्मा सर्गप्रलयकोविदः ।
विकुर्वाणः प्रकृतिमानभिमन्यत्यबुद्धिमान् ॥

meaning.en: So this great self, skilled in creation and dissolution, transforming Nature, being unwise, takes himself for what he is not.

verses.text:
तमःसत्त्वरजोयुक्तस्तासु तास्विह योनिषु ।
लीयतेऽप्रतिबुद्धत्वादबुद्धजनसेवनात् ॥

meaning.en: Joined with darkness, goodness and passion, he is absorbed in those various wombs here through not being awake, by serving the unawakened.

verses.text:
सहवासो निवासात्मा नान्योऽहमिति मन्यते ।
योऽहं सोऽहमिति ह्युक्त्वा गुणाननु निवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Dwelling together, his nature a dweller, he thinks, "I am not another"; saying, "I am what I am," he follows the qualities.

verses.text:
तमसा तामसान्भावान्विविधान्प्रतिपद्यते ।
रजसा राजसांश्चैव सात्त्विकान्सत्त्वसंश्रयात् ॥

meaning.en: Through darkness he gets various states of darkness, through passion states of passion, and through resting in sattva the states of goodness.

verses.text:
शुक्ललोहितकृष्णानि रूपाण्येतानि त्रीणि तु ।
सर्वाण्येतानि रूपाणि जानीहि प्राकृतानि वै ॥

meaning.en: White, red and black are these three forms; know that all these forms are of Nature.

verses.text:
तामसा निरयं यान्ति राजसा मानुषांस्तथा ।
सात्त्विका देवलोकाय गच्छन्ति सुखभागिनः ॥

meaning.en: Those of darkness go to hell, those of passion to the human state, and those of goodness go to the world of the gods, sharers in happiness.

verses.text:
निष्कैवल्येन पापेन तिर्यग्योनिमवाप्नुयात् ।
पुण्यपापेन मानुष्यं पुण्येनैकेन देवताः ॥

meaning.en: By sin alone without merit one reaches an animal womb; by merit and sin mixed, the human state; and by merit alone, the gods.

verses.text:
एवमव्यक्तविषयं क्षरमाहुर्मनीषिणः ।
पञ्चविंशतिमो योऽयं ज्ञानादेव प्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: So the wise call the perishable that whose object is the unmanifest; and this twenty-fifth one acts only from knowledge.
